title: Sentinel-2 pass decision
description: What the observation pipeline decided for one Sentinel-2 pass over the domain, at s2/decisions/<date>_<orbit>.json under the catalogue root. The freshness monitor (qa/freshness.py, SLO F1) reads it to tell a pass that was rightly not published (domain under 30% covered and valid) from a missing one.

orbit.description: Relative orbit, as in the ESA product name.

domain_coverage.description: Fraction of domain pixels inside the pass's data footprint.

domain_valid_fraction.description: Fraction of domain pixels covered and valid (not cloud, cloud shadow or nodata).

complete.description: Every tile that covers the domain on this orbit was present.

listed.description: Published as an observation date (README D1: at least 30% of the domain covered and valid).
